prompt: One single presentation sheet showing FOUR app-icon concepts for the same calm, premium banking app, in an even grid of 2 columns and 2 rows on a perfectly flat pure white #FFFFFF background with wide white gaps between them. Each concept is one identical rounded-square app-icon tile (iOS squircle shape, all four exactly the same size, each about 41 percent of the sheet width, with narrower white gaps), photographed exactly straight from the front, flat and parallel to the camera, no perspective, no tilt, no drop shadow outside the tile. Each tile is a real material in deep ink-blue #17284A (a clear dark blue navy, not teal, not purple, not black): fine matte cotton board with a barely visible fibre, lit by soft diffused light from the upper left, so that the relief of the mark reads through subtle highlights on its upper left edges and soft shadows on its lower right edges, like premium letterpress stationery. Inside each tile one simple bold mark, centred, about 55 percent of the tile, with generous padding, a strong silhouette that stays recognisable at 60 pixels. All four marks are one family: the same depth of relief, the same light, the same cool pale-silver foil #E6ECF5 where foil is used. Top left: a bold geometric capital letter K monogram in a clean modern sans-serif shape (not calligraphic), debossed into the ink-blue board and filled with pale-silver foil, crisp bevelled edges catching the light. Top right: one bold abstract pen flourish, hot-foil stamped in pale-silver foil into the ink-blue board: a single thick continuous stroke of uniform heavy weight (about 8 percent of the tile width, as heavy as the strokes of the K) that runs horizontally across the middle of the tile from left to right as ONE gentle smooth wave: it rises once into a soft crest, falls once into a soft trough, and ends in a short straight tapered tail, like the single final stroke of a signature. NO loops, NO crossings, NO hairlines, NO small wiggles: it must not look like any letter, number, currency sign or word. Bottom left: a perfectly circular seal disc of pale blue-grey #D6E0F0 cotton paper slightly raised from the tile, with a crisp finely milled coin-like edge (a perfect circle, NOT a wavy wax seal, NOT a scalloped badge), and one bold check mark debossed in its centre. Bottom right: the back of an ink-blue envelope filling the tile, the V-shaped flap seam pressed in as a soft crease, and at the tip of the V one small round pale-silver foil seal dot. The letter K is the only letter on the whole sheet: no other letters, no text, no numbers, no captions, no labels, no logos, no people, no faces. No gloss, no plastic, no 3D tilt, no glow, no colours other than ink-blue, pale-silver and pale blue-grey.
